name: com.undtec/wildfire
title: Wildfire Map by Underwriters Technologies
description: Wildfire hazard (USFS WHP) and WUI class at any US point. Free, no key.

tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Looks up a US street address with the US Census Geocoder and returns the matched address with its latitude and longitude.

address.description: A US street address with city and state, for example 100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701.

tools.name: get_wildfire_hazard
tools.description: Returns the USDA Forest Service Wildfire Hazard Potential (WHP 2023) class at a point in the lower 48 United States, and the wildland-urban interface (WUI 2020) class of its census block. Landscape screening information, not a property inspection or coverage determination.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), negative in the western hemisphere.
